overview: Autolus Therapeutics (AUTL) is a London-based commercial-stage CAR-T company. Its product AUCATZYL (obecabtagene autoleucel, obe-cel) is approved for adults with relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL).

AUCATZYL uses a fast off-rate CD19 binder designed to reduce the severe immune toxicities seen with other CAR-Ts. Q2 2026 net product revenue was $45.7M (+119% year over year), and full-year guidance was raised to $140–150M. Obe-cel is also in trials for lupus nephritis, pediatric ALL and progressive multiple sclerosis.

Investor thesis: AUTL is a launch-execution story with autoimmune optionality. Revenue is growing quickly and gross margins are improving, but the company still burns cash; a $250M Perceptive credit facility ($75M drawn) adds flexibility.
advantage: Differentiated safety profile with lower rates of severe CRS/ICANS, which supports outpatient use and expansion into autoimmune disease.

risks.title: Cash Burn

risks.title: Launch Execution
risks.description: CAR-T uptake depends on treatment-center capacity and manufacturing reliability.

risks.title: Competition
risks.description: Bispecifics and other CAR-Ts compete in ALL; autoimmune CAR-T is crowded.

risks.title: Debt
risks.description: Credit facility adds leverage and repayment obligations.

interpretation: $201.6M in cash plus access to additional debt; rising revenue and gross margins should narrow the burn over time.
